normal_reference.selection: sorted paths, evenly spaced indices, first 40 memory then 16 calibration, disjoint
normal_reference.feature_groups: ViTill encoder groups en[0], en[1] at 392
normal_reference.normalization: per-group z-score from memory bank, concat, L2
normal_reference.matching: batched GEMM; free all patches; spatial +/-radius position candidates across all memory images, no padding candidates

calibration.source: 16 disjoint train/good calibration normals per class
calibration.used_for: fusion variants only; standalone reference maps stay raw

gate.formula: g = 0.15 + 0.35 * exp(-max(rel_extra, 0) / 0.25), clipped to [0.15, 0.50]; rel_extra = median((d_spatial - d_free) / max(d_free, 0.02)) over calibration normals
gate.interpretation: higher relative extra distance lowers the spatial weight; bounded fixed formula, no hard-coded class weights, no test labels

conservative_fusion.formula: score = calib(base_fuse672) + w * clamp(calib(ref_spatial) - calib_q99, 0, cap) * agree; agree = 3x3 max-pool of [calib(base)>base_thr]; nothing is subtracted from base; pose alignment intentionally not applied in this run
conservative_fusion.base_threshold: calibrated median for conservative; calibrated q95 for strong
conservative_fusion.pose_alignment_note: deferred to protect the competition deadline; all variants are unaligned

variants.name: ref_adaptive
variants.definition: (1-g) * calib(ref_free) + g * calib(ref_spatial); stage-5 normal-reference map (no base score)

variants.name: ref_conservative
variants.definition: calib(base_fuse672) + 0.25 * capped positive ref residual above calibrated q99, only where both maps agree in a 3x3 neighbourhood (PRIMARY, unaligned)

variants.name: ref_conservative_strong
variants.definition: same gate with base must exceed calibrated q95, residual cap 1.0 and weight 0.5 (unaligned)

metrics.mask_source: exact original 448->392 gt transform, nearest to 256
metrics.image_score: original baseline global top1% of the postprocessed 256 map, reused by all variants

identity.image_scores_source: one baseline-global score per test image, reused by every variant
identity.normal_reference_source: train/good only; memory and calibration are disjoint
identity.gate_source: calibration normals only; fixed bounded formula
